query.normalizedText:
SELECT o.id, o.total_cents, count(oi.id) AS items
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.customer_id = $1
GROUP BY o.id, o.total_cents

findings.title: Sequential scan with an unindexed filter
findings.evidence: Seq Scan on orders filters customer_id (est. 8 of ~200000 rows, total cost 2941.59).

findings.title: Unindexed join key
findings.evidence: Join on order_items.order_id has no index, so the order_items side is scanned (~500000 rows).
